title: Jordan of Skywatchers shown a sphere in the GATE program
summary: UAPGerb tells of Jordan of Skywatchers shown a sphere in the GATE program, about late teens of Jordan (unspecified) at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: When he was involved in the gate program as a late teen, uh, intelligence or military brass and and suits and, you know, eggghheads brought in a case, opened it up, and there was the same exact sphere.

plain: A UFO commentator who goes by UAPGerb tells of a man named Jordan, from a group called Skywatchers that tries to make contact with unknown craft. UAPGerb says that when Jordan was in his late teens in a program called GATE, a schooling program for gifted students, military officers, officials and scientists brought in a case and opened it to show him a sphere exactly like one UAPGerb was discussing. If true, it would mean officials knew about such objects and were showing them to young people.
